About the job

Affiliate & Influencer Marketing Specialist

Remote | Full-time | 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern (flexible, we care about results, not clocks) | Fluent English required




Salary Range: $900 to $1,600 USD per month plus performance bonuses, based on experience.




About TopFoxx

TopFoxx is a fast-growing, women-owned DTC eyewear brand known for innovative, problem-solving sunglasses and bold product design. Our slogan, “sunglasses with a solution,” reflects our focus on function, style, and constant improvement. We’ve built a global customer base and a highly engaged social community of over 250,000 followers, driven by founder-led storytelling, product innovation, and performance-driven content.




We operate as a lean, high-performance team where speed, ownership, and results are the standard. We move fast, test constantly, and prioritize revenue impact over surface-level activity.




The Role

We are looking for a highly strategic and revenue-driven Affiliate & Influencer Marketing Specialist who can scale and manage a large, high-performing TikTok Shop affiliate network.




Your mission is simple, but demanding: Build, activate, and retain a large base of profitable TikTok Shop affiliates. Not vanity volume, real revenue, real conversions, consistent posting activity, and disciplined performance management.




You must deeply understand influencer behavior, affiliate psychology, and conversion triggers. You know how to recruit, activate, and retain creators using a gifting-only model, no paid placements.




This role requires strong marketing judgment, systems thinking, and an obsession with measurable results. You should be comfortable operating at scale, managing hundreds to thousands of creators while maintaining structure and performance standards.




1) Core Responsibilities

Build and scale a profitable TikTok Shop affiliate network, targeting thousands of active monthly posting affiliates
Recruit and develop creators across TikTok Shop, Instagram, and LTK, moving them from gifting → repeat posting → consistent revenue generation
Build and maintain a network of 5,000+ TikTok Shop affiliates and 300+ Instagram commission-based creators, driving consistent posting activity and profitable revenue growth
Prioritize revenue-generating creators over passive participants
Execute and manage a high-volume, gifting-only strategy with strict focus on ROI, margin, and conversion performance
Retain, activate, and re-engage affiliates to ensure long-term, consistent output
Actively engage with creators through outreach, messaging, and community interaction to strengthen relationships and increase performance
Track all outreach, status, and performance in a structured CRM system
Build SOPs, playbooks, and scalable systems for growth
Report performance, trends, and risks clearly to leadership
Ensure the program scales profitably (commissions, discounts, cost control)
Ad Hoc Marketing & Growth Initiatives, support broader marketing and growth efforts as needed, with a continued focus on revenue impact and speed of execution. This may include:




2) TikTok Live & Scheduling

Build and manage daily/weekly TikTok Live schedules
Identify and scale high-performing live sellers
Coordinate campaigns, promotions, and incentives
Maintain consistent collaboration pipelines with top affiliates




3) Performance Tracking & Reporting

Maintain clean, structured, and actionable data across all affiliates
Stay fully up to date on TikTok Shop Seller Center and platform changes
Track and optimize key KPIs: GMV, conversion rate, refund rate, posting frequency, revenue per creator
Scale top performers aggressively and cut underperformers quickly




4) GMV Growth & Listing Optimization

Drive GMV with a strong focus on profitable growth
Test bundles, limited-time offers, and creator-specific incentives
Optimize listings, pricing, and creative direction based on performance
Maintain catalog accuracy and listing quality across SKUs
Analyze fees, discounts, and returns to protect margins
Identify risks, opportunities, and platform shifts early




5) Partnership & Strategy Expansion

Support influencer collaborations and co-created product opportunities
Identify new creator segments, niches, and growth strategies
Continuously test and iterate new approaches to improve efficiency and scale




Requirements & Experience

2+ years of experience in Influencer or Affiliate Marketing (DTC or eCommerce preferred)
Proven experience scaling TikTok Shop affiliate ecosystems at volume
Strong hands-on experience with TikTok Shop Seller Center, including listings, commissions, fulfillment flow, and creator tools
Proven track record of generating revenue through gifting-only or low-budget affiliate strategies
Experience managing large affiliate pipelines and high-volume gifting programs
Strong understanding of conversion-driven marketing and revenue-focused growth strategies
Experience building systems, SOPs, and scalable processes to support growth
Strong understanding of U.S. social media trends, creator behavior, and digital consumer psychology
Excellent communication and persuasion skills to recruit, activate, and retain creators
Strong analytical mindset with full ownership of KPIs, ROI, and margin performance
Self-driven, highly organized, and adaptable in a fast-changing environment




Who You Are

Entrepreneurial: You take initiative and solve problems without waiting for direction
Analytical: You think in ROI, margins, and performance—not vanity metrics
Persuasive: You understand creator psychology and know how to motivate consistent posting and sales
Execution-Focused: You can manage high volume without losing structure or quality
Ownership Mentality: You take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks




Benefits

Competitive salary based on experience with performance bonuses that can bring total monthly compensation to $2,000+ USD
Performance-based bonuses tied to results
Fully remote work
PTO + paid holidays
Free TopFoxx products
Clear path to a leadership role




This is a high-ownership, performance-driven role. You will be responsible for building a real revenue engine, not managing surface-level influencer activity. If you are motivated by growth, ownership, and measurable impact and know how to build profitable affiliate systems, we want to meet you!




Don't see the perfect fit? If you believe you'd be a great addition to TopFoxx but this role isn't the best match, we'd still love to hear from you. Please email your resume and a brief introduction to recruiting@topfoxx.com and let us know which role(s) you're interested in. We're always excited to connect with exceptional talent.

title: Growth Sr Analyst Payments
skills: Entre 3 y 5 años de experiencia en roles de Growth, Revenue Analytics o Strategy en fintech, pagos o servicios financieros, operando en entornos donde el crecimiento se mide en volumen transaccional (TPV/GMV), no solo en leads o usuarios registrados.
Dominio de SQL avanzado (Redshift o equivalente) para extracción y análisis autónomo de datos sin depender del equipo de ingeniería.
Experiencia con herramientas de BI (Looker, Tableau o similares) para construir dashboards accionables orientados a decisiones de negocio.
Capacidad demostrada para diseñar y ejecutar experimentos comerciales: A/B testing, campañas segmentadas por comportamiento transaccional.

Historial de al menos una iniciativa de crecimiento con impacto medible y concreto — un incremento de TPV en un segmento, optimización de canal, campaña que movió una métrica clave. Buscamos a alguien que haya movido una aguja con datos y pueda contarlo con números.
Deseable: familiaridad con herramientas de automatización (n8n, Zapier, Make) o AI agéntica aplicada a operaciones de growth.

Licenciatura en Ingeniería, Economía, Matemáticas, Actuaría, Administración o afines. Más importante que el título: capacidad de pensar en sistemas, operar con autonomía y comunicar hallazgos complejos de forma simple a audiencias no técnicas.
Identificar y activar oportunidades de revenue incremental en Payments mediante análisis profundo de datos transaccionales (Redshift/BI), contribuyendo directamente al KR de $300M en TPV en 6 meses.

Diseñar e implementar un motor de experimentación y campañas comerciales — desde la formulación de hipótesis hasta la ejecución — automatizando flujos con AI (n8n/LLMs) para reducir el tiempo de lanzamiento de experimentos de semanas a días.

Coordinar con Marketing, Producto, Comercial y Servicing para que los insights de crecimiento se traduzcan en acciones comerciales alineadas, con una estrategia unificada que maximice conversión y retención.

Construir y mantener el sistema de medición de Growth en Payments: definir métricas clave (TPV, Approval Rate, churn transaccional, LTV por segmento) y diseñar dashboards accionables que reduzcan la dependencia de análisis ad hoc.

Liderar la agenda de automatización e inteligencia aplicada al crecimiento — mapear procesos manuales, implementar soluciones con AI agéntica y proponer modelos de propensity que permitan anticipar comportamiento transaccional y personalizar estrategias de activación por segmento.
Un ambiente de trabajo dinámico y colaborativo donde podrás desarrollar tu potencial al máximo.
Oportunidades para aprender y crecer profesionalmente utilizando tecnologías de vanguardia.
Un equipo apasionado y talentoso con el que podrás compartir conocimientos y experiencias.
Paquete de compensación competitivo y beneficios atractivos.
La oportunidad de impactar positivamente en la vida de miles de personas y contribuir al desarrollo del país.

No se requiere experiencia profesional previa para solicitar este rol; sin embargo, trabajar en este proyecto requerirá que pases los requisitos básicos y pases por un proceso de evaluación estándar. Dominio Profesional Completo del inglés y español. and Management, primarily on Meta platforms. This role is ideal for a creative, organized, and

exceptional teamwork skills are required for all of our positions. Please submit your resume or

any documentation in English. We can’t wait to meet you!

campaigns.

Acerca de Spark225

Spark225 es una firma boutique de estrategia, marketing, tecnología y crecimiento especializada en el sector salud.

Trabajamos con compañías de la industria farmacéutica, médicos y clínicas, integrando capacidades de estrategia, Growth, Creative, Technology, Medical, CRM, automatización e inteligencia artificial.

Actualmente somos una compañía compacta, cercana y en crecimiento. No somos una agencia masiva ni una organización con estructuras innecesariamente complejas. Esto implica trabajar directamente con el Founder, participar en decisiones relevantes y tener un impacto visible sobre los clientes, los proyectos y la evolución de la empresa.

Estamos entrando en una nueva etapa: proyectos de mayor complejidad, clientes más relevantes, un equipo en proceso de profesionalización y nuevas oportunidades de crecimiento. Para avanzar, necesitamos fortalecer nuestra capacidad de ejecución y construir una operación menos dependiente del Founder.




La oportunidad

Buscamos un Client Success, Strategy & Operations Manager —CSSO— que se convierta en el principal integrador de Spark225 después del Founder.

Será una posición de liderazgo transversal, responsable de conectar estrategia, clientes, equipos, datos, procesos y recursos para que los proyectos prioritarios sucedan con velocidad, calidad, claridad y rentabilidad.

No es una posición tradicional de ejecutivo de cuenta ni un Project Manager enfocado exclusivamente en seguimiento administrativo. Buscamos una persona capaz de liderar proyectos, tomar decisiones operativas, eliminar bloqueos, anticipar riesgos y construir sistemas que permitan escalar la compañía.




Tu misión

Convertir la estrategia de Spark225 en resultados concretos y sostenibles.

Deberás asegurar que:

Las prioridades se traduzcan en planes ejecutables.
Los proyectos estratégicos avancen de principio a fin.

Su ausencia deberá compensarse con aprendizaje rápido, experiencia en entornos regulados y capacidad para operar con múltiples áreas, aprobaciones y restricciones.




Cómo mediremos tu éxito

Tu desempeño estará relacionado con resultados como:

Proyectos estratégicos completados con calidad, alcance, tiempo, impacto y margen.
Retención y desarrollo de cuentas prioritarias.

Desarrollo de proyectos corporativos y alianzas de valor.
Reconocimiento como un punto de integración, criterio y resolución.




La naturaleza de la posición

En esta función, el seguimiento es importante, pero no es el resultado final.

No buscamos a alguien que únicamente persiga pendientes. Buscamos a quien pueda interpretar acuerdos, detectar implicaciones, tomar decisiones y convertirlos en resultados.

Las minutas, recordatorios y documentación pueden apoyarse en inteligencia artificial. El valor del CSSO estará en comprender qué debe suceder, quién debe resolverlo, qué riesgo existe y cómo llevar el proyecto hasta su conclusión.




Esta posición probablemente no será la adecuada si:
Prefieres operar con instrucciones completamente definidas y poca ambigüedad.

Buscas incorporarte a una organización grande, con estructuras, procesos y recursos ya totalmente consolidados.

Una empresa boutique, compacta y en crecimiento.

As a Lead Software Development Engineer, it’s up to you to define, design and refine the tech that keeps us one step ahead of listeners. Anticipate. Innovate.  Lead complex technical initiatives within your team

 Explore technical needs and bring solutions to the table

About Audible

Audible is the leading producer and provider of audio storytelling. We spark listeners’ imaginations, offering immersive, cinematic experiences full of inspiration and insight to enrich our customers daily lives. We are a global company with an entrepreneurial spirit. We are dreamers and inventors who are passionate about the positive impact Audible can make for our customers and our neighbors. This spirit courses throughout Audible, supporting a culture of creativity and inclusion built on our People Principles and our mission to build more equitable communities in the cities we call home.

A day in the life

 5+ years experience of software development and deployment of distributed multi-tier applications

title: Senior Shopify E-commerce Specialist (Revenue Growth Focus)
skills: Shopify Ecosystem Mastery: Deep, hands-on experience with Shopify Plus, including its architecture, native features, liquid code familiarity (preferred), and the app ecosystem (subscriptions, loyalty, upsells, and checkout extensions).

A/B Testing & Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO): Proven track record of designing, executing, and analyzing A/B and multivariate tests using tools like Optimizely, VWO or Replo to improve CR, AOV, and LTV.

Data Analytics & Advanced Reporting: Ability to build comprehensive revenue dashboards and attribution models. Expert-level proficiency with Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Shopify Analytics, Google Ads and Microsoft Ads turning raw data into actionable business intelligence.

Store Performance & UX Optimization: Strong understanding of web performance metrics (Core Web Vitals, page speed, mobile responsiveness) and user behavior tracking tools (Hotjar, Clarity) to identify and eliminate friction points in the funnel.

Seasonal Campaign Architecture: Experience planning and executing revenue-driving operations for high-traffic retail events (BFCM, Christmas, Summer Sales), including inventory sync logic, discount automation, and landing page deployment.
Tech Stack Integration: Ability to connect and align CRM/Email Marketing platforms (e.g., Klaviyo, Attentive) with Shopify to ensure seamless data flow and automated customer journeys.

Pricing and Promotions: Support the analysis and performance measurement of pricing strategies, discount campaigns, and promotional events across Shopify stores. Evaluate the revenue and margin impact of discounts, automatic discounts, and Shopify Scripts or Functions-based pricing rules. Maintain a structured record of all promotions run, their mechanics, their performance, and key learnings for future reference. Work with the commercial team to model the expected impact of upcoming pricing decisions before they go live. Monitor promotional cannibalization, basket composition changes, and new vs. returning customer behavior during and after campaigns.

description:
About the job

Who You’ll Work With

At Slalom we co-create custom software, data and cloud products with clients who are ready to accelerate their digital transformation. We’re passionate about technology, compelled by its potential as we help create the digital products, experiences, and technology-driven organizations that drive true change. We’re thrilled by the opportunity to build the future we want to see, with anyone willing to join us. Slalom’s Experience Design (XD) team is a group of diverse individuals who happen to be world-class multidisciplinary designers. We’re artists and technologists, sure. But we’re also athletes and farmers, carpenters and musicians, educators and data nerds, and so much more. 
 
Our growing team works closely with US and Canadian clients on complex, industry-heavy products across sectors including financial services, energy, and beyond. Together, we operate with a shared passion for building great products with great clients. Our recent expansion into Latin America has further enriched our team with diverse perspectives and innovative ideas. We are open to hiring either the Consultant (Sr. Product Designer) or Senior Consultant (Lead Product Designer) level title. 

What You’ll Do

As a Senior Designer on the Customer Experience team, you'll independently turn product requirements into high-fidelity, production-ready design for complex products in industries like financial services, energy, and enterprise technology. You'll work within established product ecosystems and existing design systems, contributing improvements as you go, and bring real craft and polish to the screens, flows, and interactions that move products forward.

Day to day, you'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with developers, product and project managers, fellow designers, and on larger engagements, design leads, translating requirements into clear, development-ready design artifacts. You'll communicate your design decisions to the team and client stakeholders, share progress in working sessions, and ask the right questions to make sure what you're designing lines up with what the client actually needs.

You'll use modern prototyping and agentic design tools to communicate intent quickly and keep design, engineering, and product aligned around a single source of truth. You'll manage your own workload and velocity with minimal oversight, anticipate and flag delivery risks early, and operate independently when the path is clear, pulling in guidance from leads when the problem space is less defined.

As you grow, you'll start connecting your work to the client's near-term goals and contribute back to Slalom's design practice through reusable patterns and shared craft, strengthening both the engagement in front of you and the team around you. 

What You’ll Bring

Senior Designers at Slalom bring strong design craft, the independence to own their own scope of work, and the experience to deliver high-polish design within real-world product environments — not just clean-slate builds. You translate defined requirements into clear, high-fidelity design, collaborate closely across delivery teams, and hold a high-quality bar on everything you ship. To meet these expectations, you'll need:

4+ years of experience in product design or UX design — experience in professional services or consulting a plus
A portfolio demonstrating strong design craft, attention to detail, and high-fidelity execution across multiple product types (web, native, and/or others)
Proven ability to independently turn requirements into production-ready design with minimal oversight
Experience working on complex, industry-heavy products (e.g., financial services, energy, enterprise platforms) not just consumer or marketing-focused work
Comfort working within existing design systems and contributing to them, including in evolving or inconsistent system environments
Fluency in modern product design software (Figma, Framer, etc.) and familiarity with agentic design and prototyping tools (Figma Make, Lovable, Claude Design, etc.)
Professional English fluency, with the ability to communicate design decisions and progress clearly to US and Canadian client teams

About Us

Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries partner with clients to co-create powerful customer experiences, modern ways of working, and meaningful impact.

What sets us apart? We believe work should be challenging and fulfilling, not perfect, but possible. That’s why we prioritize purpose, flexibility, connection, and recognition, so our people can thrive and love what they do, most days.



Desired Skills and Experience

Bar, Consulting, Customer Experience, Design, Design Systems, Detail-oriented, Energy, Engineering, English, Figma, Financial Services, Framer, Polish, Product Design, Product Requirements, Professional Services, Professionalism, Prototyping, Software, Source, Technology, User Experience Design

description:
About the job

At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.

Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.

Associate Account Manager

Introduction to the Team

Expedia Group B2B connects partners across the travel industry to our leading technology, supply, and services - helping them deliver seamless travel experiences to their customers. From airlines and hotels to financial institutions and other travel platforms, we power smarter, faster, and more impactful travel solutions through the most connected marketplace in the world.

Make an impact!

As an Associate Account Manager, you will help hotel and travel partners maximize their success on Expedia Group’s platform by building strong relationships, understanding their business goals, and providing data-driven recommendations to support growth. You will work closely with partners to improve content, rates, availability, and overall marketplace performance while identifying opportunities through marketing initiatives, promotions, and revenue management strategies. Using Expedia Group’s tools, insights, and self-service solutions, you will conduct regular business reviews, monitor partner performance, and support commercial conversations that drive results. This role combines account management, partner consulting, and analytical problem-solving to help partners increase visibility, attract more travelers, and deliver exceptional customer experiences, while also developing your own commercial and relationship management skills.

In This Role, You Will


Build developing relationships with partners and their account teams, including key buyers and decision-makers 
Create opportunities to strengthen accounts through progress meetings, fact-finding conversations, and exploratory discussions 
Learn partner business goals and challenges, then recommend products, services, and insights that align to their needs 
Complete basic account plans and use data and insights to support account growth and retention 
Attend partner meetings, identify stakeholders, and help guide straightforward commercial conversations toward productive outcomes 
Build working knowledge of contracts, internal processes, and company offerings while partnering with more senior colleagues when additional support is needed 
Support marketing campaigns, promotions, and revenue management initiatives 
Monitor partner performance and market trends 
Travel occasionally to visit partners 


Experience And Qualifications


You have 0-2 years of relevant experience 
You have a bachelor’s degree; or equivalent related professional experience 
You are proficient in English and the local language of the market you support 
You are a proficient communicator who can exchange clear information and build support in straightforward situations 
You have growing knowledge of sales techniques, and some account management experience is preferred 
You are comfortable gathering data, identifying insights, and assisting with cost, benefit, and risk analysis to support business decisions 
Problem-solving mindset and willingness to learn 
Positive attitude, resilience, and a growth mindset 


Accommodation requests

Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service-now.com/askeg?id=job_accommodation.

About Expedia Group

Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands - Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo - along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

Important notice

Employment opportunities and job offers at Expedia Group will always come from Expedia Group's Talent Acquisition and hiring teams. Never share sensitive personal information unless you are confident of the recipient. Expedia Group does not extend job offers via email or messaging tools to individuals with whom we have not made prior contact. Our email domain is @expediagroup.com. The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/.

Equal Opportunity

About the job

Description

Amazon is looking for high-potential leaders, who are ready to own their impact in Amazon Operations as an entry-level manager. We promise you will have your leadership capacity stretched to its full potential. As a front-line leader, you will have an opportunity to truly invest in others and develop a people-focused leadership style, while mastering the tools, processes, and operations that have created the most customer-centric company on Earth. If you want to be involved in continuing to define the future of online retail, and are dynamic and an organized self-starter, join our team in Amazon Operations as an Area Manager.

As an Area Manager, you will have the opportunity to lead and develop your own team of Amazon Associates in a distribution warehouse environment. Your main focus will be motivating, mentoring and coaching your team. As a servant leader, the Area Manager will ensure that their team of Amazon Associates have all the tools needed to succeed for any task during a shift. Engaging with your team during a shift to ensure that the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance performance and engagement are maintained are core functions of the role. Come learn how the largest online retailer in the world runs its fulfillment and delivery networks!

What is fulfillment you ask? Fulfillment is how we refer to completing or fulfilling a customer’s Amazon.com order and the acts of picking, packing, shipping and delivering their order to meet or exceed their expectations!

Slalom’s Experience Design (XD) team is a group of diverse individuals who happen to be world-class multidisciplinary designers. We’re artists and technologists, sure. But we’re also athletes and farmers, carpenters and musicians, educators and data nerds, and so much more. 
 
Our growing team works closely with US and Canadian clients on complex, industry-heavy products across sectors including financial services, energy, and beyond. Together, we operate with a shared passion for building great products with great clients. Our recent expansion into Latin America has further enriched our team with diverse perspectives and innovative ideas. We are open to hiring either the Consultant (Sr. Product Designer) or Senior Consultant (Lead Product Designer) level title. 

What You’ll Do

As a Senior Designer on the Customer Experience team, you'll independently turn product requirements into high-fidelity, production-ready design for complex products in industries like financial services, energy, and enterprise technology. You'll work within established product ecosystems and existing design systems, contributing improvements as you go, and bring real craft and polish to the screens, flows, and interactions that move products forward.

Day to day, you'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with developers, product and project managers, fellow designers, and on larger engagements, design leads, translating requirements into clear, development-ready design artifacts. You'll communicate your design decisions to the team and client stakeholders, share progress in working sessions, and ask the right questions to make sure what you're designing lines up with what the client actually needs.

You'll use modern prototyping and agentic design tools to communicate intent quickly and keep design, engineering, and product aligned around a single source of truth. You'll manage your own workload and velocity with minimal oversight, anticipate and flag delivery risks early, and operate independently when the path is clear, pulling in guidance from leads when the problem space is less defined.

As you grow, you'll start connecting your work to the client's near-term goals and contribute back to Slalom's design practice through reusable patterns and shared craft, strengthening both the engagement in front of you and the team around you. 

What You’ll Bring

Senior Designers at Slalom bring strong design craft, the independence to own their own scope of work, and the experience to deliver high-polish design within real-world product environments — not just clean-slate builds. You translate defined requirements into clear, high-fidelity design, collaborate closely across delivery teams, and hold a high-quality bar on everything you ship. To meet these expectations, you'll need:

4+ years of experience in product design or UX design — experience in professional services or consulting a plus
A portfolio demonstrating strong design craft, attention to detail, and high-fidelity execution across multiple product types (web, native, and/or others)
Proven ability to independently turn requirements into production-ready design with minimal oversight
Experience working on complex, industry-heavy products (e.g., financial services, energy, enterprise platforms) not just consumer or marketing-focused work
Comfort working within existing design systems and contributing to them, including in evolving or inconsistent system environments
Fluency in modern product design software (Figma, Framer, etc.) and familiarity with agentic design and prototyping tools (Figma Make, Lovable, Claude Design, etc.)
Professional English fluency, with the ability to communicate design decisions and progress clearly to US and Canadian client teams

About Us

Slalom is a fiercely human business and technology consulting company that leads with outcomes to bring more value, in all ways, always. From strategy through delivery, our agile teams across 52 offices in 12 countries partner with clients to co-create powerful customer experiences, modern ways of working, and meaningful impact.

What sets us apart? We believe work should be challenging and fulfilling, not perfect, but possible. That’s why we prioritize purpose, flexibility, connection, and recognition, so our people can thrive and love what they do, most days.



Desired Skills and Experience

Bar, Consulting, Customer Experience, Design, Design Systems, Detail-oriented, Energy, Engineering, English, Figma, Financial Services, Framer, Polish, Product Design, Product Requirements, Professional Services, Professionalism, Prototyping, Software, Source, Technology, User Experience Design

Garantizar la excelencia en el servicio postventa mediante la coordinación de servicios técnicos, el seguimiento operativo de los equipos instalados y la atención oportuna a los requerimientos de los clientes, como cotizaciones, venta de refacciones y solicitudes de servicio.




Requisitos del perfil




Carrera profesional terminada (Lic. en Negocios, Comercio Internacional, Relaciones Internacionales o afín).

Inglés avanzado.

Conocimiento deseable en empaque (Flejes, maquinas flejadoras, robots, etc)

Manejo de Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook).

Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en servicio al cliente, preferentemente en empresas con enfoque industrial.

Conocimiento de operaciones de comercio exterior




Actividades principales




Gestionar la cotización y venta de refacciones y servicios.

Dar seguimiento y coordinar solicitudes de servicio técnico.

Gestión de la importación de refacciones.

Mantener comunicación constante con clientes antes, durante y después de cada intervención.

Dar seguimiento a órdenes de compra, facturación y documentación relacionada con los servicios.

Coordinar con los departamentos de logística, facturación y servicio para asegurar una atención integral al cliente




Responsabilidades del puesto




Realizar cotizaciones de refacciones.

Recibir pedidos de los clientes y verificar precios.

Reporte de seguimiento de cotizaciones.

Ingresar a sistema la Orden de compra.

Coordinación de la importación de mercancía de Canadá, conciliar expediente de importación.

Atender requerimientos especiales de los clientes.

Realizar reporte de clientes activos en servicio.

Realizar reporte de servicios.

Realizar reporte de proyectos especiales.

Realizar reporte de proyección de ventas.

Prospección de clientes.

Realizar cotizaciones de Servicios.

Coordinar los viajes de los servicios, preparar viáticos, reservaciones de hospedaje y transporte

Seguimiento de los requerimientos de planta para ingreso de ingenieros

Generar los reportes de servicios y facturar los servicios, de acuerdo con protocolo interno.

Enviar expediente de finalización de servicio al cliente, con factura y cotización.

Seguimiento de servicios realizados, cerrar cotizaciones pendientes de los servicios.

Llamadas frecuentes con los clientes revisando Stock - Venta – Servicios.

Vender servicios de mantenimiento y pólizas.




Ofrecemos




Sueldo base competitivo.

Seguro de Gastos Medicos

Fondo de ahorro

Prestaciones superiores a la ley.

Capacitación técnica y comercial continua.

Plan de carrera con posibilidad de crecimiento.

Excelente ambiente de trabajo, con enfoque colaborativo y profesional.

description:
About the job

Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Specialist, Customer Success

Overview

Services within Mastercard is responsible for acquiring, engaging, and retaining customers by managing fraud and risk, enhancing cybersecurity, and improving the digital payments experience. We provide value-added services and leverage expertise, data-driven insights, and execution.

Delivering with excellence for our customers is of the utmost priority, and we are expanding our Services Customer Success team to achieve this goal. This team plays a crucial role in ensuring our customers achieve their desired outcomes while maximizing the value of our products and services. Customer Success (CS) boosts Customer Lifetime Value, increases renewals and adoption, reduces support tickets, improves product feedback, builds advocacy for B2B marketing, and generates qualified sales leads.

This team will work collaboratively with cross-functional partners to address customer needs, develop tailored strategies that enhance customer satisfaction and retention, and build customer advocacy. Key outcomes of the CS team’s work will be qualified leads for value expansion and feedback for product and process improvements. By focusing on proactive engagement and personalized service, the Services Customer Success team fosters long-term relationships and contributes to the overall growth and safety of the Mastercard ecosystem.

 As a Specialist, Customer Success for Services, you will support the development and delivery of strategic priorities within the region. The candidate will focus on ensuring the priority customers and segments they work with experience positive change through more effective use of Services network products. The candidate will support senior Customer Success Managers and work closely with cross-functional teams including Network Services, Account Management, Sales, Product, Technical Account Managers and support/delivery teams to realize the full value proposition of Mastercard Network Products on behalf of the customer.

The three areas of primary responsibility include: 1) customer engagement, 2) growing the business, and 3) technical and program readiness.

Customer Engagement:


 Engage with stakeholders to study the viability of proposed solutions and understand cyber threats in financial and payment sectors
 Identify optimization opportunities for customers with the goals of driving customer value and enhanced strategic goals through our products
 Articulate key performance indicators related to cost, performance and optimization and the insights associated with them



Growing The Business:


 Leverage Mastercard Services’ offerings to achieve customer goals and realize value propositions of Mastercard products
 Identify opportunities for additional Mastercard products to create greater value potential for customers and enhance impact of Network Product offerings
 Ability to evaluate business models, partnerships, and agreements ensuring product business cases are financially viable and supported by solid data



Technical & Program Readiness:


 Develop training materials, thought leadership, and customer-facing playbooks that can be scaled internally and externally to support customer priorities and Customer Success value proposition
 Translate complex technical capabilities into effective solutions that address customer needs in a clear and customer-centric manner
 Gather and report customer feedback on product gaps and pain points. Use stakeholder insights to refine value propositions and improve products



All About You:


 Experienced at leveraging insights from market analysis, customer engagements, and identified opportunities to inform strategic decisions, drive innovation, and sustain competitive advantage
 Knowledge and understanding of payments technology or cybersecurity (threat intelligence or risk management) and application of that knowledge to address customer/market needs in these areas are a plus
 Experience using tools and technology to provide data analytics and business intelligence on cyber threats, fraud, risk and vulnerability
 Proven ability to translate complex technical capabilities into effective solutions that address customer needs in a clear and customer-centric manner
 Experience in analyzing customer metrics and leveraging data to drive customer success initiatives that contribute to mutual profitability and growth
 Experience in identifying “next opportunity” for customers to further enhance the strength and value of the partnership for both parties
 Experience in creative thinking and development of innovative solutions to complex customer challenges
 Enthusiastic individual who works seamlessly with a diverse high performing team, nurtures a winning and inclusive culture, and a focus on development at the individual and team level
 Experience working with at least some of the following: large and emerging Technology, Financial Services, Acquirers/Processors, Service Providers, and/or digital platform partners
 Languages - English and Spanish; Portuguese desirable



Corporate Security Responsibility

All Activities Involving Access To Mastercard Assets, Information, And Networks Comes With An Inherent Risk To The Organization And, Therefore, It Is Expected That Every Person Working For, Or On Behalf Of, Mastercard Is Responsible For Information Security And Must:


Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

About the job

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Open Role: Marketing Associate 

Marketers at Canonical are brand stewards and demand creators.They transform complex open-source technology into messages, stories and strategies that shape the market understanding of our vision. Some focus on differentiated product and portfolio positioning; others specialize in account-based engagement, partner and alliance messaging, or product-led growth. Whatever their specialization, each marketer works as part of a cross-functional unit, contributing campaigns and insights that help the company learn and grow faster.

We have a bias for action, focus efforts on the most impactful activities and take ownership of our results. We work across long buying cycles, balance storytelling with data, design experiments, track outcomes, and iterate rapidly to find what works.

Marketers at Canonical don’t just promote open source; they amplify it, ensuring our innovations reach the right people, at the right time, with clarity and purpose from developers to decision makers.

As a Marketing Associate , you won't just be watching from the sidelines; you will be hands-on from day one, collaborating with cross-functional teams to translate complex technical innovations into compelling market value.

Location: This role will be based remote globally

What Your Day Will Look Like


GTM Support: Contribute to go-to-market planning and execution. 
Storytelling: Draft and edit compelling messaging and positioning that highlights business value for diverse target audiences. 
Campaign Coordination: Assist in developing campaign plans and content dissemination strategies to ensure our message reaches the right people. 
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with other demand generation and digital teams to help optimize marketing funnels and track campaign performance. 
Event & Social Support: Work with the wider marketing team to coordinate webinars, events, and social media promotions. 



What We Are Looking For In You


Tech Curiosity: A genuine passion for technology and a desire to learn about open source. 
Analytical Thinking: An ability to break down complex issues and translate them into clear, actionable recommendations. 
Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships within a fast-paced, cross-functional environment. 
Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills; you enjoy storytelling and creating impactful content. 
Proactive Mindset: A self-starter who can prioritize tasks effectively and meet deadlines in a dynamic setting. 
Foundational Knowledge: A basic understanding of marketing principles or go-to-market strategies (via your degree, internships, or personal projects). 
Growth Mindset: Someone who is eager to learn, open to feedback, and not afraid to take on new challenges.

About the job

The Next Level of Fire & Life Safety Leadership

With more than two centuries of combined history, brands like Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, Gloria and Aritech have been leading the way in protecting people and property around the world. Now, we’re taking that leadership to the next level. Kidde Global Solutions brings together the most trusted and iconic brands in safety, building upon our shared experience and expertise to address the needs and challenges of more customers in more places. With an unmatched portfolio of solutions and services, and a commitment to constant innovation we’re elevating the standards for an entire industry – and establishing the next level of fire and life safety leadership.

At Kidde Global Solutions, you’re joining a global technology leader in fire and life safety solutions and our employees are the heart of it all. With industry-defining brands in life safety and security, you’ll be part of a legacy of leadership working with cutting-edge technologies that protect lives and property worldwide. As a leading fire safety brand, our mission is to provide solutions that protect people and property from the effects of fire and related hazards. You’ll be part of a company that prioritizes quality, integrity, collaboration, and customer care, with the resources, training, and incentives to ensure your success every step of the way.

About This Role

Kidde is seeking a Brand Sales professional to support various distribution channel management activities. This role is responsible for supporting commercial leadership, product commercialization, and strategic market execution for Edwards and Kidde commercial fire and life safety solutions across multiple countries.

The Brand Sales professional acts as the primary regional interface with global sales, product management, engineering, operations, and key customers, translating market requirements into compliant, commercially viable solutions that drive growth, customer satisfaction, and long-term market adoption.

The individual will partner with sales executives across the region to develop and promote strong product and application knowledge and apply it to channel partners, A&E firms, integrators, and end-user customers, with the intent to drive specifications and brand awareness.

Weekly 


 Support the regional sales team with customer service issues, demand planning, and forecasting.

 Visit integrators to gather market intelligence and channel partner feedback.

 Stay current on required quarterly online ethics training and certifications.


Travel Requirements


 Ability to travel up to 60% of the time.


Basic Qualifications


 Bachelor’s Degree preferred.

 Portuguese language skills preferred (not mandatory)


Preferred Qualifications


 Excellent written and verbal presentation and communication skills.
 Basic computer skills.
 High energy level, with strong product and code knowledge and application expertise.

World Leaders in Fire and Life Safety

About the job

Are you passionate about marketing, media, and digital innovation? Join our Continence Care team and gain hands-on experience supporting media and digital initiatives for one of our leading brands.

About The Role

As a Media & Digital Intern, you will work closely with experienced marketing professionals, agencies, and cross-functional teams to support the execution, monitoring, and analysis of media campaigns across digital and traditional channels. This is a unique opportunity to learn about media planning, campaign performance, SEO, content development, brand building, and consumer engagement while contributing to real business projects.

You will develop valuable skills in media and digital marketing, gain exposure to the end-to-end campaign process, and collaborate on initiatives that help strengthen our brands and connect with consumers in meaningful ways.

If you are curious, analytical, organized, and eager to learn, we would love to hear from you.

What You Will Do


Assist in the execution and follow-up of media activities across traditional and digital channels, supporting awareness, consideration, and trial objectives.
Support the implementation and tracking of the media mix plan for the Continence Care (TENA) brand.
Assist in monitoring media KPIs and compiling campaign performance reports.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams and agency partners to support media and marketing initiatives.
Support the media planning process through coordination of materials, timelines, and meeting follow-ups.
Assist in gathering consumer, market, and competitive insights to identify potential opportunities across media touchpoints.
Learn about emerging media trends, tools, and innovations, and share relevant findings with the team.


Who You Are


A current undergraduate student pursuing a degree in Marketing, Communications, Advertising, Business, Digital Marketing, or a related field.
Eager to learn and gain hands-on experience in both digital and traditional media.
Organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
Proactive, curious, and willing to take initiative while learning from experienced professionals.
Analytical and comfortable working with data, reports, and performance metrics.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Collaborative team player who enjoys working with different stakeholders and functions.
Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel and PowerPoint.
Intermediate to advanced English proficiency preferred.

Our purpose, Breaking Barriers to Well-Being, provides meaning to everything we do. Join us to improve well-being for people and drive positive change for society and the environment.
